verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost the same: the hashtag bar floats in the top left with no clear connection to the rest, the symptom list runs from the very top of the banner to the bottom with no margin, and the list breaks badly ('breath Dry / cough' leaves 'cough' alone on its own line). In A, the symptom list nearly touches the end of the '6 SYMPTOMS' headline, and the yellow call-to-action text sits right up against both the bottom of the illustration and the 'Pain in chest' line. B leaves slightly more room between the headline and the list, and puts its call-to-action cleanly under the illustration, so it is a little less cramped.
